headline: Garuda Construction discloses board meeting outcome
hook: Routine board meeting update from Garuda Construction

modes.bear: The announcement contains no operational or financial updates, offering zero visibility into business performance.
modes.bull: Routine exchange filings show the company is actively complying with all regulatory and corporate governance requirements.
modes.simple: The company simply filed a routine update about a board meeting to the stock exchange, with no new business details announced.

summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited has announced the outcome of its board meeting held on November 28, 2026. The company submitted this regulatory update to the stock exchange as part of standard corporate compliance procedures. For an Indian retail investor, routine procedural filings of this nature have no immediate impact on stock price or company fundamentals.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail investors from routine compliance filings.

headline: Garuda Construction files financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This routine regulatory filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Shareholders and prospective investors can review the reported revenue, margins, and net profit figures on the exchange portals. The update enables retail investors to track the company's operational execution against prior quarters.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the fundamental performance of your holdings.
